description: Pause a multi-use card: temporarily blocks ALL new charges (reversible — use resume_card to unblock). Right for "stop this subscription for now" or a card the user suspects is compromised but is not sure. Only multi-use cards can be paused; single-use cards close after one charge and cannot be paused.

approval_id.description: Approval id from a prior approval_required response, once the user has approved. Only for cards created through ANOTHER app: first call without it (the user is emailed an approve link), then retry with it.

card_id.description: The card ID to pause (from list_cards or create_card).

name: pause_card

status.description: "paused" on success; an error discriminator otherwise (e.g. "not_multi_use", "card_not_updatable").
